verdict.rationale: Vast.ai publishes its own REST API reference section and serves a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, so an official API reference exists. The evidence never shows that the reference is interactive or that its examples can be run from the docs. A probe confirms the offer-search endpoint answers keyless requests, which hints that live calls are feasible, but that is not an in-docs runnable example. Missing for 10: evidence of an interactive try-it console, runnable request examples within the reference, and independent hands-on corroboration of the reference experience.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: The Vast.ai REST API gives you programmatic control over the entire platform. It's the foundation that the CLI and SDK are built on.
the offer-search REST endpoint is public
